title: Dispatch Note on Gallons Reserved for the Next Scheduled Fill
content:
Where a booking on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts stands against a tank on the automatic keep-full schedule, part of the gallons standing to the member's credit is spoken for by the fill the schedule will make next, and that part is held back from the gallons still undrawn. What is held back depends on how busy the account has been.

| The tank and the account stand thus | What is held back from the gallons still undrawn |
| --- | --- |
| The tank stands on the automatic keep-full schedule, and 3 or more stops were made on the account in the twelve months ending on the handling date | The gallons the automatic schedule will take at the next stop, counted as the programme's fill-to percentage of the tank's water capacity less the gauge reading the driver took on arriving at the most recent stop, before any fuel was pumped, taken on that capacity and rounded to one decimal place |
| The tank stands on the automatic keep-full schedule, and fewer than 3 stops were made on the account in that window | The programme's trigger percentage of the tank's water capacity, rounded to one decimal place |
| The tank does not stand on the automatic keep-full schedule | Nothing is held back from the gallons still undrawn |

## The reading the first line takes

The gauge reading the first line is measured from is the arrival reading of the most recent stop: what the driver's gauge showed on arriving at the site, before any fuel was pumped.

## Reading the count

The count is of stops made on the account in the twelve months ending on the handling date. At 3 stops or more the first line governs; at 2 stops or fewer, the tank still being on the automatic schedule, the second governs. A tank off the automatic schedule falls to the third line whatever the count.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical inputs)

*A busy automatic account.* A tank of 1000.0 gallons water capacity stands on the automatic keep-full schedule on a programme whose fill-to percentage is 80 percent, and 5 stops were made on the account in the twelve months ending on the handling date. At the most recent stop the driver's gauge read 35 percent on arriving, before any fuel was pumped, and 80 percent once the fill was finished. The first line takes the arrival reading of 35 percent, so the held-back gallons are 80 percent less 35 percent of 1000.0 gallons, coming to 450.0 gallons.

*A quiet automatic account.* The same tank on a programme whose trigger percentage is 30 percent, with 2 stops in that window, holds back 30 percent of 1000.0 gallons, coming to 300.0 gallons, and neither gauge reading enters the count at all.

*A tank off the schedule.* The same tank, not on the automatic keep-full schedule, holds back nothing, whatever the stop count and whatever the gauge read.
